bestiary.elysiumbestiary.bane.automaton: Nothing but the right metal marks it.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.bane.basilisk: Meeting its eye slows you to a standstill. Do not look at it.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.bane.chupacabra: What it takes from your health, it keeps. Eating does not give it back.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.bane.drake: It burns through whatever you are holding up.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.bane.kobold: It takes what is in your hand and runs. Kill it to get it back.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.bane.kobold_war: There is never one of them, and each is braver for the others.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.bane.pegasus: It goes where you cannot follow.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.bane.sporeling: What it leaves behind is still there when you stop to breathe.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.anchor: Will not be pushed, and pushes hard.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.call: Calls up one more of its own family.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.charge: Winds up, then crosses the room in one line.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.chill: What it touches gets slower and colder.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.drift: Walks to where you are going rather than where you are.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.leap: Jumps the gap you were counting on.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.split: Comes apart when it dies, and the pieces keep coming.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.stalk: Stops dead when you look at it. Moves when you do not.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.does.sunder: Goes through the wall rather than round it.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.bristler: It goes for whatever is going for you.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.copper_gol: Tell it what to press and it presses it.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.crab: Stand near one and you can reach further.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.glare: It points at ground dark enough for something to stand on.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.iceologer: What is fighting you slows down near it.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.illusioner: There appear to be several of you.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.mauler: Stand near one and the ground gives way faster.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.moobloom: Flowers come up where it has been.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.rascal: Find it three times and it pays out.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.tuff_golem: Give it something and it will hold it where it stands.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.gift.wildfire: What stands too close to it catches.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.ashquail: Three steps, stop, three steps. Never four.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.brackhog: It got to the mushrooms first and it is not sorry.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.breaker: It goes through the wall rather than round it, every time.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.cragjay: It has been following you for a mile, for no reason it will share.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.dunemare: Nothing else out there is that colour on purpose.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.fellox: It will move when it has finished, and not before.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.glasseel: You see the shadow before you see the thing.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.hollow_lord: It waited. Whatever it was waiting for, it was not you.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.husk_ox: Too heavy to knock back and too slow to run from. Pick one.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.keener: The noise arrives first and the cold arrives with it.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.mirefowl: Loud, and entirely unbothered about being loud.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.moorstag: It watches you the whole way across the clearing and does not run.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.mourner: It is not chasing you. It is going the same way you are.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.quillrat: Picking one up is a decision you make exactly once.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.ripper: Fast, and it has worked out that you are slower going uphill.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.shalecrab: It has found somewhere to be and it is not moving.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.shardling: It comes apart when you hit it and the pieces keep coming.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.siege_beast: Three metres of it. Bring the door down and leave.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.silverfin: A whole shoal turns at once, as if the water told them.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.stalker: You will hear it stop following you. That is the bad part.
bestiary.elysiumbestiary.why.stonemole: You hear the digging stop. It has heard you too.
